workspace.demoNote: Demo: nothing is written to Hermes. The facts and skills below are examples.
workspace.filesNote: These facts are files you own, under the Hermes home (~/.hermes/shared-memory/). Every bot can read them. A bot’s own MEMORY.md and USER.md stay private. A change is picked up the next time a session starts.
workspace.hindsight: Hindsight is the memory provider for {{names}}. It keeps its own bank. The facts on this screen are the files you edit; they are not copied into that bank.
workspace.emptyType: No facts of this kind yet.
workspace.factPlaceholder: A fact every bot should know
workspace.privateEmpty: No private notes in the bots’ own memory files.
workspace.skillsNote: The shared library is every bot’s starting set. A skill that lives in one profile is listed under that bot. Enabling or disabling writes that profile only.
workspace.skillsEmpty: No skills found for this bot.
workspace.skillsUnsupported: This Hermes does not list skills.
workspace.hubUnsupported: This Hermes has no skills hub. Install a skill from Hermes, then it shows up here.
workspace.sheetNote: The name and the avatar are the bot’s card. Instructions are its SOUL.md. The model and the toolsets are its profile. A new session picks up the instructions and the toolsets.
workspace.name: Name
workspace.personaPlaceholder: Who this bot is and how it should work
workspace.toolsetsReadOnly: This Hermes does not toggle toolsets from here. The names below are the ones already enabled for this profile.
workspace.toolsetsUnsupported: This Hermes does not list toolsets.

errors.memory_full: Shared memory is full. Forget a fact first.
errors.memory_unreadable: A memory file could not be read, so nothing was changed.
errors.memory_unwritable: The memory file could not be written.
errors.memory_not_found: That fact is no longer there.
errors.invalid_profile: That bot is not a Hermes profile.
errors.skill_toggle_failed: The skill could not be updated.
errors.persona_unwritable: The instructions could not be written.
errors.model_unwritable: The default model could not be saved.
errors.workspace_failed: Hermes did not accept the change.
